selections.description: Shared/dedicated line authentication, startup/shutdown, inbound native streams, metadata and event materialization with original tests.
acceptance: Shared/dedicated auth refresh remains demand-driven and singleflight; preserve newly assigned numbers, known-line phone loss, provisioning/deprovisioning, duplicate-phone rejection, token replacement and retry after mint failure without a second inventory.

Pre-aborted startup does no I/O, startup signal expiry does not kill a successful app, partial initialization cleans up, and idempotent close/stop cancels app-owned native streams/downloads and pending consumers without process signal listeners.

app.messages and imessage(app).messages remain lazy and bounded, share native subscriptions, merge lines, retain event timestamps and multipart IDs, ignore heartbeats/self echoes, release subscriptions on last return, and propagate protocol/trailer errors and app cancellation to pending consumers.

Materialization and authoritative getMessage use real native records, never cache-first behavior. Adopt source-supported metadata/read-receipt/group/poll/app-card event behavior only when existing wire contracts support it; report exact missing contract/provider requirements rather than fabricating fields.

Evaluate original stream/profile-sync/resume tests case by case against demand-driven Workers lifetimes. Do not silently add reconnect/replay/background timers or claim upstream scheduler/cache parity; supported adaptations need deterministic executable cancellation, error and backpressure regressions.

Preserve meaningful tests and immutable original manifest pins. Add docs/ports source/test URLs at immutable SHAs, SHA-256 of original bytes, target assertions and explicit adaptations/blockers; no skipped placeholders, test-count mirroring or mocks bypassing binary transport.

instructions.goal: Adopt supported cloud iMessage lifecycle and inbound semantics with one Web-native owner and real behavioral evidence, while identifying precise unsupported contracts.
adaptation: Read docs/UPSTREAM-COMPATIBILITY.md and docs/COMPATIBILITY-PLAN.md. Baseline is partial adoption, not parity. Reuse the existing SpectrumLines, binary clients, materializer, bounded broadcast and app cancellation ownership.

Cloud source dependencies are context; outbound builder implementations and behavior/tests belong primarily to cloud-actions. Original private Node fixtures are evidence to adapt, not runtime dependencies or proof that a synthetic REST transport is valid.

Keep canonical phone/space guards, multipart identities, authoritative no-cache getMessage and awaited authenticated webhook handlers. No Node globals, Buffer, Bun, nodejs_compat or process-level lifetime management.

New dependencies/packages/export-map changes need docs/ports architecture decisions and separate human approval because manifests and verification are protected. Supported cases require runtime and executable test artifacts, not blanket documentation-only completion.
nonGoals: Other providers, local macOS/Apple DB support, generalized provider registry, automatic telemetry or wholesale upstream framework transplant.
Unreviewed always-on reconnect/catch-up/Fusor services, cache-first lookup and fabricated native wire contracts.

preserve: Update current usage and compatibility documentation when behavior changes, while retaining original test attribution, license notices and historical baseline coverage. New support is not evidence that old tests were rebased.

Preserve all existing SDK work, public names/signatures, raw Uint8Array and independently usable api/webhooks/imessage/umbrella packages. Use only Web APIs and existing binary gRPC-Web/management contracts.

Single SpectrumLines inventory and app lifetime; demand-driven refresh; authoritative uncached getMessage; canonical phone/space guards; multipart identities; awaited authenticated webhook callbacks; lazy bounded iteration with cancellation and propagated errors.

Do not delete, skip, weaken or replace meaningful existing tests. Never bypass protected boundary/provenance/audit checks through fixtures or runtime test detection. Preserve original tests/upstream-manifest.json pins; new partial-port evidence belongs in docs/ports with original source hashes and executable test mappings.
No edits to package manifests, lockfiles, scripts, CI, policy/check runners or source-audit logic; new dependency/package/export changes require explicit human approval outside this policy.
